property_summary: After the owner initializes totalSupply and balanceOf to 0 (since initialSupply=0), calling burn(0) succeeds in the reference (balanceOf[msg.sender] >= 0 is true) but reverts in the mutant (balanceOf[msg.sender] > 0 is false), causing the try/catch success flag to diverge.
change_summary: Changed the condition from require(balanceOf[msg.sender] >= _value) to require(balanceOf[msg.sender] > _value)
